title: 1993 AMC 8 Problem 1
statement: Which pair of numbers does not have a product equal to \(36?\)

solutions.text:
Checking each pair: \((-4)(-9) = 36,\) \((-3)(-12) = 36,\) \(\dfrac12 \times (-72) = -36,\) \((1)(36) = 36,\) and \(\dfrac32 \times 24 = 36.\)

Only \(\dfrac12 \times (-72) = -36\) fails to equal \(36.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C .
hints: Multiply the two numbers in each pair and check which product is not \(36\)
A negative times a negative is positive, so watch the signs of \(\dfrac12 \times (-72)\)
